title: queryOnce()
description: Runs a single, non-reactive query against a collection. Filters, ordering, limits, and joins are pushed to PostgREST where possible. Aggregates like `count` and `sum` run on the server. Other operations, like `distinct` and computed fields, are applied client-side.

params.name: callback
params.description: A query builder function describing the query to run once.

params.name: supabase
params.description: The Supabase client instance to run the query against.

notes:
- Aggregates use PostgREST aggregate functions, which are disabled by default. Enable them with `alter role authenticator set pgrst.db_aggregates_enabled = 'true';` followed by `notify pgrst, 'reload config';`.
- `groupBy` and `having` aren't supported yet.

examples.name: Run a one-time query
examples.code:
```tsx
import { eq } from '@tanstack/react-db'
import { queryOnce } from '@supabase-labs/tanstack-db'

const completed = await queryOnce(
  (q) => q.from({ todo: todos }).where(({ todo }) => eq(todo.completed, true)),
  supabase
)
```
